meta.title: Skilled Worker route present, but the rating blocks new CoS

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer — Core Product
Stonebridge Softworks Ltd · Borough, London

Stonebridge builds inspection-management software for UK construction: snagging, handover, compliance evidence. Site managers use us on 2,000 active projects.

The core team works in Kotlin and PostgreSQL on the offline-first sync engine that makes the product work in a basement with no signal.

We're after 2+ years of backend experience; mobile sync experience is a strong plus.

£44,000 base. Visa sponsorship offered. 25 days holiday, hybrid (2 days Borough), quarterly hack weeks that ship. Process: intro call, technical deep-dive on a sync problem, team lunch.

expected.determining_fact: Stonebridge Softworks Ltd has a Skilled Worker route row, but its licence rating means no new Certificate of Sponsorship can be issued while the rating stands.

design_notes: The amendment-3 archetype: same shape as gbm_only — the row exists and the verdict is still NOT_SPONSORABLE — but the disqualifier is the Type & Rating column, not the Route column. Every naive signal is green here (offer, salary, route row). The solver-side rating sub-check remains Saturday-only-if-holds; until it lands this case scores against the solver, honestly.
